name: Kettlebell Bent Press
steps: Rack one bell at your shoulder and stand with your feet wide and toes turned slightly away from that side.
Set your elbow against your side and keep the forearm vertical as you shift your loaded hip back.
Hinge away from the bell and move your torso under it until your arm straightens.
Stand tall beneath the bell, lower it to your shoulder and switch sides.
tips: Keep your forearm perpendicular to the floor and actively wedge yourself under the bell rather than pushing it vertically like a strict press.
Bend your knees as needed to keep your feet grounded and the bell balanced over your base.
